content.title: What time is The Boys season 5 out on Prime Video?
content.text: We're now just hours away from seeing the final season of The Boys, with new episodes beginning to drop weekly starting on Tuesday 7 April.While we don't yet know how the season will play out, Butcher star Karl Urban has teased that the season will mark a "big crescendo", while also telling Variety that big things happen right from episode 1.He said: "Every season, but particularly this season, from episode 1 you're like, 'Oh wow.' Like, nobody is safe. Like, fatalities, right from the get go. Let's go, last season, it's all on."It isn't just the conclusion, the blood and guts or the potential for big deaths that fans are looking forward to. There's also a Supernatural reunion on the way, with Jared Padalecki and Misha Collins joining their former co-star Jensen Ackles for the new season.Speaking with TVLine recently, Ackles wouldn't be drawn on what brings the duo in to the season, but did tease that he has a "wild scene" with them both."I don't think I can say anything about why the scene happened," he said. "But I will say that it's an episode that is... definitely one to to keep a lookout for, because the whole sequence is bananas."He said of Padalecki and Collins: "We still see each other quite a bit and talk all the time, and we're still very much a part of each other's lives, so it didn't feel like much time had passed. It just felt like we were back together again doing what we do."But as we head towards the new episodes, exactly what time can viewers expect them to be available on Prime Video.Want to see this content?This page contains content provided by Google reCAPTCHA. Jasper Savage/Prime VideoNew episodes of The Boys season 5 are released on Prime Video on Wednesdays at 8am BST in the UK, starting from Wednesday 8 April.Around the world, that works out to the following times:12am (midnight) PT (USA)2am CT (USA)3am ET (USA)8am BST (UK)9am CET (Central Europe)3pm AWST (Australia)5pm AEST (Australia)The first two episodes of The Boys season 5 will be released at once, with additional episodes arriving one a week until the finale drops on Wednesday 20 May.The Boys. Jasper Savage/Prime VideoThe synopsis for the new season of The Boys says: "In the fifth and final season, it’s Homelander’s world, completely subject to his erratic, egomaniacal whims. Hughie, Mother’s Milk, and Frenchie are imprisoned in a 'Freedom Camp.' Annie struggles to mount a resistance against the overwhelming Supe force. Kimiko is nowhere to be found."But when Butcher reappears, ready and willing to use a virus that will wipe all Supes off the map, he sets in motion a chain of events that will forever change the world and everyone in it. It’s the climax, people. Big stuff’s gonna happen."The Boys season 5 premieres on Prime Video on 8 April 2026 – try Amazon Prime Video for free for 30 days.
